en.title: SAT1 crosses regional boundaries; livestock risk now depends on surveillance and vaccine matching
en.deck: Official SAT1 notifications across the Middle East, Asia and Africa, plus a November FAO-WOAH field mission in Mongolia, show a transboundary livestock risk whose economic impact depends on laboratory capacity, vaccine compatibility, animal-movement controls and regional reporting.
en.regime: SAT1 has been reported beyond its historical range; national surveillance and response capacity are uneven and the 14-country Middle East strategy is now an institutional framework.
en.key_risk: SAT1 reaches additional susceptible herds before serotype-matched prevention, laboratory confirmation and movement controls are deployed, causing localized production losses and wider temporary trade restrictions.

pt-BR.title: SAT1 ultrapassa fronteiras regionais; o risco pecuário depende de vigilância e compatibilidade vacinal
pt-BR.deck: Notificações oficiais de SAT1 no Oriente Médio, Ásia e África, junto à missão de campo FAO-WOAH na Mongólia em novembro, mostram um risco pecuário transfronteiriço cujo impacto econômico depende de laboratórios, compatibilidade vacinal, controles de movimentação e reporte regional.
pt-BR.regime: SAT1 foi notificado além de sua área histórica; a capacidade nacional de vigilância e resposta é desigual e a estratégia de 14 países do Oriente Médio constitui agora um marco institucional.
pt-BR.key_risk: SAT1 atingir novos rebanhos suscetíveis antes da implementação de prevenção compatível com o sorotipo, confirmação laboratorial e controles de movimentação, causando perdas locais e restrições temporárias mais amplas ao comércio.

signal_rationale.delta: The existing corpus search found no SAT1/FMD report. New official notifications in November and the 24 November WOAH Middle East page update provide a date-specific cross-border livestock/market-access delta distinct from the 23 November AMR implementation-gap report and today's Global Macro.
signal_rationale.evidence: FAO reported a government-requested FAO-WOAH field assessment after SAT1 outbreaks in Mongolia's Bayan-Ulgii and Khovd provinces on 13 November. WOAH lists Botswana SAT1 on 17 November and Algeria SAT1 on 10 November, while Mauritius reported serotype O on 19 November; the report explicitly separates the serotypes and diseases. WOAH's 24 November Middle East page describes the regional SAT1 spread and 2026–2030 strategy.
signal_rationale.scale_path: Serotype spread across livestock jurisdictions → veterinary surveillance and laboratory confirmation → vaccine matching and movement controls → production/market-access interruptions → farm income, trade and public response costs.
signal_rationale.transmission: Infection and control measures can reduce animal productivity and restrict movement/export certification; delays and uneven reporting increase uncertainty and can widen trading-partner restrictions. Price and loss effects require country/product data and are not estimated here.
signal_rationale.falsifier: The systemic-risk thesis weakens if notifications stabilize with stable surveillance, affected zones remain contained, vaccine compatibility/coverage and veterinary capacity are verified, and trade restrictions remain short and narrowly targeted.

key_constraints: First-occurrence country notifications are not total outbreak counts or herd prevalence.
The 2026 count in the WOAH August summary is incomplete for the calendar year.
The Mongolia FAO update reports a field assessment, not a complete national incidence or loss estimate.
FMD serotype O in Mauritius and African swine fever in Nigeria are separate events from SAT1.
Vaccine compatibility is source- and region-specific; no product-level recommendation is made.
No food-price, livestock-loss or trade-loss estimate is calculated without affected herd, output and product-level trade data.

producer_checks.comparative_corpus: GitHub repository search found no SAT1/FMD article in the indexed corpus; existing AMR and Bundibugyo items are distinct and not duplicated.
producer_checks.novelty_decision: One date-specific thematic report selected after Global Macro; new official November notifications and regional update support a distinct animal-health, production and trade-governance delta.
